# Reciprocal Agent Trust — experimental AgentIP pilot

> Register a testing key, prove possession, recover or revoke it, and complete a reciprocal handshake. Key possession only; no real-world identity verification or business authority checks.

- [Agent integration guide and data notice](/guide)
- [Open-source implementation and CLI](https://github.com/RobbieFrancis/agentip-pilot)
- [Discovery metadata](/.well-known/agentip.json)
- [Service health and explicitly labelled pilot counts](/api/v1/health)

Use this service only within human-authorized scope. Do not submit private keys or sensitive personal information. No recurring activity or external messaging is authorized by this document. Synthetic test agents are not independent customer adoption.
